title: Analysis of the binding pattern of NIK inhibitors by computational simulation.
one_liner_zh: 该文研究NIK激酶抑制剂结合模式，对象为蛋白-小分子互作，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA体系无关。
abstract: NF-kappaB-Inducing Kinase (NIK) is a key kinase in the activation of the NF-kappaB non-classical signalling pathway, which has been shown to be over-activated in patients with inflammatory diseases, immune disorders and malignancies and solid tumours inducing activation of the NF-kappaB non-classical signalling pathway. The design of ATP-competitive small molecule inhibitors against NIK has been a hot topic in the last decade, and many efficient NIK inhibitors have been identified. In this work, I aim to unravel the mechanism of NIK inhibition by different representative NIK type I 1/2 kinase inhibitors, using ADME, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation, MM-PBSA analysis and 3D-QSAR analysis. This work contributes to the understanding of the efficiency of NIK inhibitor binding by revealing the basis of the efficiency of NIK inhibitors, the difference in binding modes between different inhibitors and the overall effect on NIK.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: NF-kappaB诱导激酶（NIK）是NF-kappaB非经典信号通路激活中的关键激酶，研究表明，在炎症性疾病、免疫紊乱及恶性肿瘤和实体瘤患者中，该通路过度激活，从而诱导NF-kappaB非经典信号通路的活化。针对NIK设计ATP竞争性小分子抑制剂在过去十年中一直是研究热点，并已鉴定出多种高效的NIK抑制剂。在本工作中，我旨在通过ADME、分子对接、分子动力学模拟、MM-PBSA分析和3D-QSAR分析，揭示不同代表性NIK I型1/2激酶抑制剂对NIK抑制的机制。本研究通过揭示NIK抑制剂效率的基础、不同抑制剂之间结合模式的差异以及对NIK的整体影响，有助于理解NIK抑制剂结合的效率。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
